# A deterministic Python page

This example supplies executable content for the project's own documentation.
The configured Python kernel shares state across all four cells.

::: {.callout-note}
Execution requires the collection's explicit permission. These cells use only
local values and the IPython display helpers provided by the declared kernel.
:::

```{python}
#| label: setup
#| echo: true
values = [2, 4, 6]
total = sum(values)
```

```{python}
#| label: streams
import sys

print(f"Total: {total}")
print("Example stderr", file=sys.stderr)
```

```{python}
#| label: markdown
from IPython.display import Markdown

Markdown(f"**Total:** `{total}`")
```

```{python}
#| label: figure
#| fig-alt: The total is twelve.
from IPython.display import SVG

SVG(f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="160" height="60" viewBox="0 0 160 60"><rect width="160" height="60" fill="#edf2f7"/><text x="16" y="38" fill="#1a202c">Total: {total}</text></svg>')
```
